changes: Serialize reset requests and confirmations with other account security operations.
Re-check the active account, selected email and allowed role under lock before creating a link.
Only the latest requested reset remains usable; successful reset consumes all remaining links and closes the account's sessions atomically with its audit.
Throttle reset requests, token attempts and MFA changes with hashed subjects; repair orphaned counters whose expiry write was interrupted.
Hide new and legacy reset-link content, subjects and failure details from notification list/history; search uses only the redacted content and manual retry is unavailable.
The internal notification worker retains original message access for authorized delivery.

verification.unit_tests: 30 passed: throttle, controller-before-mutation ordering and notification retry rules.
verification.scope: Actual services and SQL/migrations with synthetic accounts. Reset table stores token hashes; queued delivery content is retained internally but never returned through public notification history. Fake hashing, fake queue and fake provider; no real email, Redis or production authentication was used.

dependencies: Session migration 083 must precede the new API.
